comp=str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA")
def rc(x): return x.translate(comp)[::-1]

# homopolymers
import re
print("Homopolymers >=7:", [(m.group(), m.start()+1) for m in re.finditer(r"(A{7,}|T{7,}|G{7,}|C{7,})", s)])

# inverted repeats (palindrome arms >=10, loop <=25) - simple scan
def palindromes(minarm=10, maxloop=25):
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        for arm in range(minarm, 31):
            for loop in range(0, maxloop+1):
                j=i+arm+loop
                if j+arm>n: continue
                if s[i:i+arm]==rc(s[j:j+arm]):
                    out.append((i+1, j+arm, arm, loop, s[i:i+arm]))
    return out
pals=palindromes(11,20)

seen=set(); best=[]
for a,b,arm,loop,seq in sorted(pals, key=lambda x:-x[2]):

    seen.add(a); best.append((a,b,arm,loop,seq))
